import org.leanbridge.nominalsubtypes.kotlin.*
fun first(value: Envelope) = Api.first(value)
fun second(value: Envelope) = Api.second(value)
fun combine(left: Envelope, right: Envelope) = Api.combine(left, right)
fun nested(value: EnvelopePair) = Api.nested(value)
fun echo(value: Envelope) = Api.echo(value)
fun aliases(left: Array<Option<Envelope>>, right: Array<Option<Envelope>>) = Api.aliases(left, right)
fun echoGroups(value: Array<Option<Envelope>>) = Api.echoGroups(value)
fun echoPair(value: AliasPair) = Api.echoPair(value)
fun inspectAliasPair(value: AliasPair) = Api.inspectAliasPair(value)
fun eventFirst(value: Event) = Api.eventFirst(value)
fun eventSecond(value: Event) = Api.eventSecond(value)
fun echoEvent(value: Event) = Api.echoEvent(value)
fun plainFin(value: java.math.BigInteger) = Api.plainFin(value)
